scripts.dev:api: bun run --cwd packages/evidence build && bun run --cwd apps/api start:dev
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/evidence build && bun run --cwd packages/reviews build && bun run --cwd apps/api build && bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/evidence build && bun run --cwd packages/reviews build && bun run --filter '@archgauge/*' typecheck
scripts.test: bun run build && bun test apps/api/tests apps/web/tests packages/evidence/tests packages/reviews/tests
scripts.test:coverage: bun run build && bun test --coverage apps/api/tests apps/web/tests packages/evidence/tests packages/reviews/tests
